home.tagline: A cozy place to listen to music with friends.
home.nicknameInvalid: Pick a nickname with 1 to 16 characters.
home.desktopOnly: bumbadum is made for computers. Open this link on a desktop or laptop to join.

joinRejection.room-full: The room is full. Try again in a little while.
joinRejection.invalid-nickname: That nickname can't be used. Pick one with 1 to 16 characters.
joinRejection.invalid-avatar: That avatar can't be used. Pick another one on the home page.

waiting.usually: Our server takes a nap when nobody's around. Waking it usually takes up to a minute.
waiting.timedOut: The server is taking much longer than usual to wake up. Sorry about that!

notice.rate-limited: Easy there: at most 5 messages every 5 seconds.
notice.play-missing-track: Tell /play what to play: a YouTube link or video ID.
notice.play-not-a-video: That link doesn't point to a YouTube video.
notice.play-search-unavailable: Searching by name isn't available yet. Paste a YouTube link instead.
notice.track-not-found: Couldn't find that video on YouTube.
notice.track-lookup-unavailable: Can't look up tracks right now. Try again in a little while.
notice.track-live: Live streams can't play on the radio.
notice.track-not-embeddable: That video can't be played outside YouTube.
notice.track-too-long: That track is longer than 10 minutes.
notice.track-on-air: That track is on air right now.
notice.track-already-queued: That track is already in the queue.
notice.track-too-many-waiting: You already have 3 tracks waiting. Let one play first.

wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
wardrobe.hint: Only you see these changes until you wear them.

radio.nothingPlayingHint: Type /play and a YouTube link in the chat to start the radio.
